stages.description: 本階段聚焦「洪峰預報偏差帳」與「分段庫容積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flood forecast bias account: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洪峰預報偏差帳」如何影響長江三峽大壩工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flood forecast bias account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型水庫調度先把預報入流與可控制出流分開。入流偏差會隨時間積分成庫容偏差，即使瞬時流量差看似不大，也可能持續耗用預留空間。模型必須以相同時間窗對齊雨量預報、支流到達與下游限制，不能把更新前後的預報當成兩股來水。 逐時正負誤差可能在期末抵消，但最大累積偏差仍決定需要保留的暫時空間，應同時報告兩種量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洪峰預報偏差帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir scheduling separates forecast inflow from controllable release. Inflow bias integrates over time into storage error, so a modest flow discrepancy can consume reserved space when it persists. Rainfall predictions, tributary arrival and downstream restrictions must share a time window; forecast revisions are alternative estimates, not additional streams of water. Positive and negative hourly errors may cancel at the endpoint, while the maximum cumulative error still determines temporary space requirements; report both quantities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flood forecast bias account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每次預報更新都應另加一筆來水」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every forecast revision should be counted as an additional inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洪峰預報偏差帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Flood forecast bias account”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flood forecast bias account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洪峰預報偏差帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flood forecast bias account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3。模型邊界：偏差在整段期間固定，忽略水面雨量蒸發及取水；只計預報誤差體積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3. Model boundary: constant bias throughout the interval, omitting surface rainfall, evaporation and withdrawals; this is forecast error volume only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3。模型邊界：偏差在整段期間固定，忽略水面雨量蒸發及取水；只計預報誤差體積。

steps.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flood forecast bias account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洪峰預報偏差帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flood forecast bias account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。另查出流儀表是否延遲，若流量偏差與水位變化不閉合，先排除時間戳及曲線版本不同，不直接調整防洪限制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation. Check release-meter delay separately. If flow imbalance and level change disagree, investigate timestamps and curve versions before interpreting the discrepancy as lost flood space. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立六小時誤差帳，再把偏差改成前半正值、後半負值，分別比較最大暫存量與期末淨增量，說明兩者對預留空間的意義不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a six-hour error account, then reverse the bias sign halfway through. Compare maximum temporary storage with the final net increment and explain why they imply different space requirements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預報低估若與出流受限同時發生，庫容偏差會持續累積；但水位異常也可能來自回水或量測基準漂移，必須以第二種水量證據區分，不能只憑單站水位判斷預報失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underprediction combined with constrained release accumulates storage error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。另查出流儀表是否延遲，若流量偏差與水位變化不閉合，先排除時間戳及曲線版本不同，不直接調整防洪限制。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation. Check release-meter delay separately. If flow imbalance and level change disagree, investigate timestamps and curve versions before interpreting the discrepancy as lost flood space.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立六小時誤差帳，再把偏差改成前半正值、後半負值，分別比較最大暫存量與期末淨增量，說明兩者對預留空間的意義不同。
knowledge.textEn: Build a six-hour error account, then reverse the bias sign halfway through. Compare maximum temporary storage with the final net increment and explain why they imply different space requirements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「洪峰預報偏差帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flood forecast bias account"?
options: 將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
總電量相同就代表爬坡影響相同
optionsEn: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal total energy means that ramp trajectories have equivalent effects.
quiz.explanation: 將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flood forecast bias account: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洪峰預報偏差帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flood forecast bias account” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預報低估若與出流受限同時發生，庫容偏差會持續累積；但水位異常也可能來自回水或量測基準漂移，必須以第二種水量證據區分，不能只憑單站水位判斷預報失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underprediction combined with constrained release accumulates storage error. An unusual level can also reflect backwater or datum drift, so a second water-balance observation is needed before assigning the discrepancy to forecast failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：逐時正負誤差可能在期末抵消，但最大累積偏差仍決定需要保留的暫時空間，應同時報告兩種量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Positive and negative hourly errors may cancel at the endpoint, while the maximum cumulative error still determines temporary space requirements; report both quantities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每次預報更新都應另加一筆來水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every forecast revision should be counted as an additional inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piecewise storage integration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位與庫容通常不是固定面積的線性關係，山谷展寬會讓同一水位增量對應不同體積。用相鄰高程的水面面積做梯形積分，是資料稀疏時可檢查的近似；但支流庫灣及回水的空間差異仍須另外處理，不能把單站水位當成全庫水平面的證明。 若測深採用的水位基準與岸線高程不同，整張容量曲線會偏移，因此測量基準屬於模型輸入的一部分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分段庫容積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water level and storage are rarely related by one constant surface area. A widening valley gives different volumes for equal level increments. Trapezoidal integration between surveyed areas provides a transparent approximation when data are sparse, but tributary bays and backwater remain spatial effects that a single gauge cannot resolve. A mismatch between bathymetric water-level datum and shoreline elevations shifts the capacity curve; reference control is therefore part of the model input. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piecewise storage integration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3。模型邊界：相鄰斷面的面積隨高程線性變化且假設靜水面；不是完整庫容曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 分段庫容積分：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分段庫容積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piecewise storage integration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以相同垂直基準疊合兩次測量輪廓，檢查支流庫灣是否被遺漏，再把高程間距減半比較積分變化。若細分結果差異集中在一段高程，應補查地形轉折，而非以整庫平均面積掩蓋局部誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay survey contours in one vertical datum and check missing tributary bays. Halve the elevation interval and compare integrated volumes. If the change concentrates in one elevation band, investigate a terrain transition rather than hiding local error behind a reservoir-wide mean area. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出三個高程的面積曲線，加入中間面積與端點線性值不同的情境，計算粗細兩種積分差並提出最值得補測的高程區間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plot areas at three elevations and make the middle area differ from linear interpolation. Calculate coarse and refined volumes, then identify the elevation band where another survey would be most valuable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：岸線插值錯誤會讓可用庫容被高估，尤其在淹沒平台突然展寬的位置；這類幾何誤差與蒸發損失的時間特徵不同，可用靜水測量及多次水量閉合分辨。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incorrect shoreline interpolation can overstate usable storage, especially where a submerged terrace widens abruptly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 水位控制失準會改變槽內總重，造成原先平衡假設不成立；導輪卡阻也會提高電流，但不會以相同方式改變靜態重量，兩者需靠停機稱重與方向試驗區分。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incorrect level control changes total trough weight and invalidates the balance assumption. A binding guide also raises current without the same static weight change, allowing weighing and direction tests to distinguish the two mechanisms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大船入槽一定等量增加升降總重」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Net head power account" and "Electrical ramp energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 淨水頭功率帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Net head power account: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淨水頭功率帳」如何影響長江三峽大壩工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Net head power account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電水頭是能量高程差扣除引水系統損失，不是壩高或水庫高程的同義詞。尾水抬升與攔污柵阻塞都會降低淨水頭，卻有不同的量測位置及維修責任。把水力功率、軸功率與電功率依效率串接，才能避免在不同儀表邊界間重複扣損。 速度水頭必須和壓力水頭使用相容斷面，若兩端斷面差異很大，僅以靜水位差代替能量差會有偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淨水頭功率帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Generating head is the energy-level difference after conveyance losses, not dam height or reservoir elevation. Tailwater rise and trash-rack blockage both reduce net head but have different measurement locations and maintenance implications. Distinguish hydraulic, shaft and electrical power when applying efficiencies so that losses are not deducted twice across instrument boundaries. Velocity and pressure heads require compatible sections; markedly different inlet and outlet sections make a simple static-level difference an incomplete estimate of energy difference. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Net head power account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩高可直接當作機組淨水頭」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dam height can be used directly as turbine net head." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淨水頭功率帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW。模型邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，效率為水力輸入至電端總效率；未計暫態及可用率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
